Responsive and new library variants are mapped to their reviewed parent/source and decoded for dimensions; they are renditions, not additional independent photos.
The three video originals were visually sampled at start, middle, and end. This inventory does not claim a complete audio/content review of every original video frame.
Exact duplicate groups use SHA-256. Camera-image families include recompressed/resized derivatives. Collection membership can mean a subject grouping, not a proven common property.
claim_boundaries: Do not infer an address, completion date, permit, inspection result, budget, investment return, or client identity from imagery.
Named project associations come from the existing site/curation context, not an independent verification of property identity.
interior-buildback, exterior-work, finished-details, and bathroom-details are subject collections; do not combine their contents into an implied before/after project.
